tmp:0877: davar echad la-dor — "one leader/spokesman per generation" (Sanhedrin 8a dictum), here a designation of Malkhut as the singular divine word/speech inserted into impurity by sin
tmp:0878: yetedot u-masmerot — pegs and nails (Rashi's gloss of sikkta), symbolizing words of Torah as "nails well-planted" per Ecclesiastes 12:11
tmp:0880: kisse in the Torah-domain — the "throne" as Torah's concealment: matters that Atik Yomin covered, hiding themselves within Torah narratives
tmp:0881: devarim she-kissah Atik Yomin — the esoteric matters "which the Ancient of Days concealed" (Pesachim 119a), secrets cloaked in the Torah's stories
tmp:0883: pechatim — pits/ditches (from the Tanna's parable), symbolizing the mineral element (domem) whose bad traits the tzaddik's face nullifies
tmp:0884: domem — the inanimate/mineral element, lowest of the four kingdoms, source of a class of bad character traits
tmp:0889: hastarat panim — divine hiding of the Face, the state of concealment identified with judgments (dinim) and Israel's distress
tmp:0890: the love with which the Holy One loves you — divine love as the reason both mercy (YHVH) and judgment (Elokim) are for one's good; echad = gematria ahavah
tmp:0891: panah oref — "turning the back of the neck," the divine posture of judgment (din), opposite of the face which is compassion
tmp:0892: din ve-rachamim — the paired attributes judgment-and-mercy, corresponding to the two yods of "vayyitzer" and the vowel tzeirei
tmp:0893: dina de-malkhuta dina — the halakhic principle "the law of the kingdom is law," civil-royal judgment as an aspect of din/Malkhut
tmp:0894: de-yitbarkhun kulhu shita yomin — Zoharic phrase "so that all six weekdays be blessed," the purpose of Shabbat eating as source of the week's abundance
tmp:0896: dalut — poverty/destitution as a spiritual state (not the letter dalet), the impoverished condition linked to the garment/skin of tefillin passage
tmp:0898: shilya — the placenta/afterbirth, womb-membrane where the fetus rests, forming the closed-mem shape from the two "doors of the womb" (Job 3:10)
tmp:0900: admimut — redness as substance: the menstrual-blood red (dam niddah) in wine and in the woman's excessive bleeding, emblem of unsweetened din
tmp:0901: the stain and grease-spot on his garment — the ketem/revav of ritual stain law, symbolizing serpent's defilement and menstrual blood from disgracing the kingdom
tmp:0904: be-Shabbat — on the Sabbath day as halakhic time-frame for visiting the sick, when one says "She [Shabbat] can have mercy" (Shabbat 12a)
tmp:0905: knowing the Torah — the third cognitive stage after learning and understanding, which constitutes Da'at (knowledge) among the three intellects
tmp:0908: achdut shel chesed u-gevurah — the unification of Kindness and Severity, the essence of Da'at: not distinguishing chesed from din, blessing ha-tov ve-hameitiv on all
tmp:0912: Bilaam — the gentile prophet of Balak's story, counterpart to Moshe as the da'at of the kelipah ("among the nations there arose — Bilaam")
tmp:0913: da'at di-kelipah — the knowledge/intellect of the husk (unholy side), the impure counterpart of Moshe's holy da'at, embodied in Bilaam
tmp:0914: da'at kol Yisrael — the collective knowledge/consciousness of all Israel, which Moshe embodies as the generation's da'at
tmp:0915: da'ato shel he-chakham — the sage's da'at (knowledge) as the "man seated upon the throne" of the Merkavah imagery; "without knowledge the soul is not good" (Prov 19:2)
tmp:0917: derushei ha-Torah — homiletical expositions of Torah via the thirteen hermeneutic principles, drawn from the thirteen tikkunei dikna, aspect of hadrat panim
tmp:0919: derekh ha-memutza — the middle/mean path that inclines neither right nor left, identified with mishpat, the central pillar
tmp:0920: chasid — the pious one distinguished by good deeds (paired with lamdan in Torah), imitating God, corresponding to the name Hashem Tzeva'ot
tmp:0921: emet ha-amiti — the truest/ultimate truth, the highest grade of truthful speech before God, whose attainer is lit by God's own light
tmp:0922: kefiyat ha-yetzer — subduing/coercing the evil inclination, the act through which one reveals love/Chesed, the "day that goes with all days"
tmp:0923: mitzvat tzitzit — the commandment of fringed garments, a protection against the serpent's counsel and sexual immorality (covering arayot, per Tikkun 18)
tmp:0924: limud zekhut on the wicked — the act of advocating merit for a rasha, by which one is saved from his evil eye (as God too defends the wicked to shield the tzaddik)
tmp:0925: being saved from the evil eye — the person's rescue from the rasha's ra ayin, achieved through finding merit in the wicked one
tmp:0926: shor she-ba-nefesh — the "ox" within the soul: the polished light added to the soul when its scattered fragments are gathered and the will shines
tmp:0927: hadlakat ha-ner — the act of kindling the (Chanukah) lamp near the doorway, embodying the illumination of glory ("the earth shone from His glory")
tmp:0928: he'arat ha-kavod — the illumination/shining of divine glory (Ezekiel 43:2, "the earth shone from His glory"), enacted by lighting the candle and returned to its root in yirah
tmp:0929: shulchan — the table as site of eating in holiness, a person's table being keter malkhut (Yoma 72b), the aspect of kavod/King of Glory
tmp:0930: he'arat panim — the shining of the Face: divine countenance turned toward the glory, opposite of hastarat panim caused by gluttonous eating
tmp:0931: the distinction between man and beast — humans nursing from breasts placed "at the place of binah" (Berakhot 10a) vs. animals nursing below; understanding as the human differentia
tmp:0933: hevel ha-yofi — "charm/beauty is vain" (Prov 31:30) read as the vain breath: the cessation/interruption of breathing, the nations' empty havalim that bring no rain
tmp:0936: hagdalat ha-sekhel — enlargement of the intellect/mochin (embodied in tefillin), expanding the mind to grasp God's daily hints
tmp:0938: dwelling in the air of Eretz Yisrael and "having a God" — the state attained by clapping hands in prayer, per "whoever dwells in the Land is as one who has a God" (Ketubot 110b)
